high_level_description: This image captures a serene sunset scene over a coastal landscape. The sun is low on the horizon, casting a warm, golden-orange glow across the sky. The clouds are tinged with hues of orange, pink, and purple, adding to the tranquil and picturesque atmosphere. In the foreground, there is a mix of vegetation, including bushes and small trees. Some of the trees have sparse foliage, suggesting it might be late autumn or early spring. A row of young trees with budding leaves is visible on the right side of the image, indicating new growth.
